title: British Embassy Rome
description:
The British Embassy Rome maintains and develops relations between the UK and Italy. 
It also hosts the UK Representation to the United Nations agencies in Rome.

title: UK Mission to the European Union
description: The UK Mission to the EU (UKMis Brussels) ensures the UK’s interests are promoted and explained to EU member states and the EU institutions.

title: UK Mission to the WTO, UN and other international organisations (Geneva)
description: The UK Mission engages with every country or organisation that is a member of, or an observer to, an international body where we are also members or observers.

title: UK Mission to UN in New York
description: The United Kingdom Mission to the United Nations in New York covers a wide range of the Foreign and Commonwealth Office's objectives from the peaceful settlements of disputes to protecting the environment, from respect for human rights to promoting sustainable development.

title: UK Joint Delegation to NATO
description: The United Kingdom’s Joint Delegation to NATO (UKDel NATO) is the link between the UK government and the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation.

title: UK Delegation to the OSCE
description: The UK Delegation to the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe (OSCE) seeks to work with and through the OSCE and its 57 participating States to protect the UK's interests, people and values. The OSCE has a uniquely comprehensive approach to security, which covers a broad range of issues across the Euro-Atlantic and Eurasian region, "from Vancouver to Vladivostok".

title: UK Mission to the UN in Vienna
description: The UK Mission to the United Nations Vienna represents UK interests in a range of international organisations covering diverse topics from reducing the risk from nuclear proliferation and armed conflict to countering piracy and increasing  sustainable development.

title: UK Delegation to the Council of Europe
description: The Council of Europe (CoE) is a pan-European organisation of 46 member states, including all 27 member states of the European Union. The United Kingdom was one of the founding members. Set up shortly after the end of the Second World War, the CoE’s core mission is to promote human rights, democracy and the rule of law across the continent.

title: UK Permanent Delegation to the OECD
description: The UK Delegation (UKDEL) represents the United Kingdom at the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) in Paris. We are an independent mission, sharing the same building as the bilateral Embassy. Our Ambassador is Andrew Wood.

title: UK Mission to ASEAN
description: The UK Mission to ASEAN aims to deepen our engagement with ASEAN, building on existing collaboration and exploring new ways to collaborate with the organisation and its member states.

title: UK Representation in the Commonwealth
description: The Commonwealth is a voluntary association of 56 independent and equal countries, representing over 2.7 billion people across 5 continents.

title: British Embassy Paris
description: The British Embassy in Paris maintains and develops relations between the UK and France. The UK's network in France and Monaco supports the government's main aims overseas: keeping Britain safe, making Britain prosperous and helping British nationals.

title: British Embassy Addis Ababa
description: The British Embassy in Ethiopia maintains and develops relations between the UK and Ethiopia.

title: British Embassy The Hague
description: We maintain and develop relations between the UK and the Netherlands.

title: British Embassy Washington
description: The British Embassy Washington maintains and develops relations between the UK and the United States.
